t: You're looking at a retail building at 191 to 199 Tottenham Court Road and 18 to 26 Torrington Place, in the London Borough of Camden. It was designed by three architects. Edward Maufe is best known for Guildford Cathedral and the Air Forces Memorial. Arnold Dunbar Smith and Cecil Brewer worked together as Smith and Brewer, the practice behind Mary Ward House in London and the National Museum and Gallery in Cardiff, both Grade I listed. I don't have more detail on the building itself, so those architects are the main thing to know here.
